description: Focused excerpt from a retained REA observation, not the complete Evidence record
limitations: Static symbol evidence establishes function identity, not runtime hotness.
The provider executable version was not probed.
Matching pre/post digests do not prove the exact bytes consumed during inspection.

additional_observation.method: Direct GNU objdump disassembly of the REA-identified function
additional_observation.interpretation: The shipped candidate loop computes hash bucket indices with integer division and follows hash-chain pointers. Runtime cost was measured independently with the sampler benchmark.
